answer: A diversity threshold stops bulk fakes: standing needs 20 distinct counterparties. Like yarrow spreading by many roots, an identity roots across the market; a 10-credit deposit gains score per counterparty. A raven ranges the whole valley, not one nest: identities confined to one lagoon of the same partners are flagged and lose the deposit. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 10,000 credits; an honest agent pays one deposit and keeps its earnings.
